page_title: ATA 3-0 MON | Atalanta v Monza 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+4' A brilliant cross into the box finds Emil Holm (Atalanta), who directs his header towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
90+1' Warren Bondo (Monza) is penalised for a foul. Matteo Marcenaro had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' That will be all from Sead Kolasinac who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jose Luis Palomino (Atalanta).
89' The ball is cleared after Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
87' Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
83' It's like he was asking for a caution. Armando Izzo (Monza) receives a yellow card.
81' Charles De Ketelaere goes off the pitch and Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) comes on.
81' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Gianluca Scamacca and he is replaced by Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
79' The linesman points to the corner flag, Atalanta are going to take it.
78' Armando Izzo (Monza) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
75' The referee allows time for a substitution. Matteo Ruggeri will be replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
75' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emil Holm (Atalanta) replacing Davide Zappacosta.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Jose Machin (Monza) is brought on as a substitute for Andrea Colpani.
73' The goal by Atalanta is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
73' The Atalanta players joy may have been justified, because referee Matteo Marcenaro is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
72' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Bondo (Monza) comes onto the pitch for Roberto Gagliardini.
66' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Pablo Mari is replaced by Andrea Carboni (Monza).
65' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Matteo Marcenaro due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) and his team.
64' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

62' 3 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) and Teun Koopmeiners gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 3:0.
60' Here is a change. Gianluca Caprari is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Samuele Vignato (Monza).
60' Substitution. Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) has come on for Dany Mota.
59' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Pablo Mari (Monza) for his blatant foul.
56' Monza will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' Andrea Colpani (Monza) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
53' Free kick. Monza will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
51' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and it's Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
49' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' Dany Mota (Monza) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
47' Ederson (Atalanta) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
46' The whistle blows and Matteo Marcenaro starts the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Matteo Pessina (Monza) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

42' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) makes it 2:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Matteo Ruggeri and planted his close-range header into the top of the net. Michele Di Gregorio was helpless.
39' Atalanta have a corner.
38' Flag goes up against Patrick Ciurria (Monza) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
38' Andrea Colpani (Monza) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Juan Musso stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
35' The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
35' 1 - 0 Ederson (Atalanta) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
31' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
31' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
29' Atalanta will take a corner kick.
29' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
28' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
25' The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
25' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
23' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
20' A cross into the box from Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is cleared.
20' Dany Mota (Monza) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Dany Mota (Monza) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
18' Monza win a corner.
18' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
11' The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

10' Armando Izzo (Monza) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marcenaro interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Atalanta, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
8' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
7' A pass from Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is intercepted by Juan Musso and the move breaks down.
6' My Gran could have done better! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
4' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Monza will kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
